case.goal: CramerGAN two-sample unbiased energy distance (Bellemare et al., NeurIPS 2017) on 9-mode 3x3 overlapping heterogeneous-mass 2D Gaussian mixture.
case.sampling: 9-mode 3x3 2D Gaussian mixture at {-1.5, 0.0, +1.5}^2 (sigma=0.16, weights=(0.18, 0.08, 0.18, 0.08, 0.16, 0.08, 0.10, 0.06, 0.08)); learned 256-particle prior; two independent fake draws per update
case.scope: Tier 4 multi-sample unbiased energy distance (CramerGAN, Bellemare et al., NeurIPS 2017) on 9-mode overlapping heterogeneous-mass 2D Gaussian mixture.
case.title: Nine overlapping heterogeneous Gaussians: CramerGAN two-sample energy distance

reproducibility.conditions: case-owned architecture, prior, sampling, batch size, update budget and scoring cadence
reproducibility.historical_evidence: original source, seed and initialization retained; no regrading

timing.excludes: initial inventory/queue wait and post-run artifact/media export
timing.includes: fixture initialization, updates, source binding, sampling and evaluation
timing.method: monotonic elapsed execution; CUDA synchronized at observations
